column1: -- SELECT o.code,o.status,p.id,p.status,p.metadata->>'requiresRefund' AS requires_refund,p.metadata->>'lateApproval' AS late_approval FROM orders o JOIN payments p ON p.order_id=o.id WHERE o.id='cp-brief16-orders-order-payment-pending' ORDER BY p.created_at; SELECT action,entity_type,entity_id,metadata FROM audit_logs WHERE entity_id='cp-brief16-orders-payment-payment-pending' AND action IN ('payments.confirmed_after_order_paid','payments.confirmed_on_cancelled_order') ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 3; SELECT recipient_id,type,title,metadata FROM notifications WHERE metadata->>'paymentId'='cp-brief16-orders-payment-payment-pending' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 3;
